title: Siegfried-Guggenheim-Weg, Offenbach
description:
This spacious, furnished 3-room apartment provides everything you need for comfortable and relaxed living. The furnishings include high-quality furniture and appliances that create a welcoming, home-like atmosphere.

Living and Dining Area:
The open-plan living and dining area is perfect for cozy evenings and social gatherings. It features two comfortable couches, a coffee table, and a side table. A TV provides entertainment, and the dining area has an extendable dining table with ample seating, ideal for shared meals.

Kitchen:
The modern kitchen leaves nothing to be desired. It is fully equipped with a stove, oven, toaster, kettle, coffee maker, as well as dishes and cooking utensils. Additionally, there is a dishwasher, a washer and dryer, and a fridge-freezer.

Bedrooms:
The master bedroom includes a cozy double bed, a spacious wardrobe, and a desk, ideal for work or study. The second bedroom is also stylishly furnished with a vanity table and an extra wardrobe.

Bathroom:
The bathroom is a small wellness paradise, featuring a luxurious Jacuzzi, a standing shower, and a bidet – perfect for unwinding after a long day.

Loggia:
The cozy loggia invites you to relax and offers a wonderful view of the well-kept neighbor’s garden and the adjacent woodland path. It’s the perfect spot to unwind at the end of the day.

This apartment offers not only excellent amenities but also a pleasant living environment where you will feel at home right away. Everything you need is included in the apartment, so additional rooms or storage areas are not available. A parking space is possible to be rent.


Additional Information

The residential area in Offenbach am Main is well-connected and practical for commuters as well as residents who value good infrastructure and proximity to important locations.

    Distance to the Airport

Frankfurt International Airport (FRA) is about 18 kilometers away. By car, it takes around 20-25 minutes to reach, depending on traffic. Alternatively, the airport is also conveniently accessible by public transportation.

    Public Transportation (ÖPNV) Connections

Offenbach is excellently integrated into the regional public transportation network. There are several bus stops and train stations nearby, and the Offenbach Central Station is approximately 2 kilometers away. From there, S-Bahn lines (S1, S2, S8, S9) offer quick connections to Frankfurt and other cities, allowing you to reach Frankfurt’s city center in 10-15 minutes.

    Shopping Facilities

There are various shopping options for daily needs in the vicinity, including supermarkets and drugstores. The Ring-Center offers a wide range of shops and services, and the Offenbach city center also provides a good selection of retail stores and outlets.

    Distance to Frankfurt am Main

The center of Frankfurt am Main is about 10 kilometers away. By car, Frankfurt’s city center is reachable within 15-20 minutes. Alternatively, the S-Bahn provides quick connections, allowing you to get to Frankfurt’s city center in about 10-15 minutes.

This location offers a peaceful residential atmosphere while providing easy access to Frankfurt and the surrounding areas. The proximity to transportation links, shopping options, and the airport makes this area especially attractive for those who value good accessibility and practical infrastructure.


*Maximum occupancy: 3 people (2 adults, 1 child)

title: Goerdelerstraße, Offenbach
description:
✔️ Fully furnished and equipped – just bring your suitcase and personal items
✔️ Bed linen and towels included for your convenience
✔️ Flat-screen TV, high-speed internet, and a personal contact person during your stay
✔️ Washer available in basement (~€3 per wash) or bring your own machine

This newly renovated, fully furnished apartment offers a comfortable and stylish home in a quiet residential area of Offenbach. Located on the first floor with a private balcony, the apartment is move-in ready and perfect for short- or long-term stays.

Inside, you will find a separate bedroom with a double bed and wardrobe, a cozy living area with a couch, a dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen with a stove, oven, refrigerator, microwave, and all necessary utensils. A flat-screen TV and high-speed internet are also available. The monthly rent of €1,600 is all-inclusive – it covers utilities, internet, and furniture. Regular cleaning is the responsibility of the tenant.

For your laundry, you can either bring your own washing machine (connections available in the basement) or use the shared washing machine in the basement for approximately €3 per load.

📍 About the Area
Located at Goerdelerstraße 35, 63071 Offenbach, this apartment sits in a calm and well-connected residential neighborhood. You'll find grocery stores, local shops, parks, and public transport options just a short walk away. Offenbach's city center is nearby, and Frankfurt is easily reachable via S-Bahn or road – ideal for commuters or city explorers. The area offers a great balance of urban living with peaceful green surroundings.

Feel free to reach out for more info!

title: Schumannstraße, Offenbach
description:
Schöne, helle, exklusiv eingerichtete Wohnung im 2. OG mit separatem Zugang in ruhiger Umgebung. Die Küche ist vollständig eingerichtet. Im Keller ist eine Waschmaschine und Trockner vorhanden. Bettzeug und Handtücher stehen ausreichend zur Verfügung. Das Apartment ist bestens geeignet für Einzelnutzung (oder ein Paar). Schlaf- und Wohnzimmer ist durch eine Schiebetür getrennt. Die Räume haben jedoch auch separate Zugänge. Die Wohnung befindet sich im Musikerviertel von Offenbach mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. 14-tägiger Reinigungsdienst ist in der Mietpauschale inkludiert. Das Haus wurde 2018 und 2022 aufwendig modernisiert.

Beautiful, bright, exclusively furnished apartment on the 2nd floor with separate access in a quiet area. The kitchen is fully equipped. A washing machine and dryer are available in the basement. Bed linen and towels are provided. The apartment is ideal for single occupancy (or a couple). The bedroom and living room are separated by a sliding door. However, the rooms also have separate entrances. The apartment is located in the musicians' quarter of Offenbach with good transport connections. A 14-day cleaning service is included in the rental fee. The building was extensively modernized in 2018 and 2022.

title: An der Mannsfaust, Frankfurt am Main
description:
Die Wohnung befindet sich im zweiiten Obergeschoss eines gepflegten Mehrfamilienhauses aus dem Jahre 1966in gutbürgeliche Wohlagee von Frankfurt Oberrad. Die Wohnung ist  renoviert.
Sie  verfügt über zwei gut nutzbare und zentral begehbare Zimmer, ein Tageslichtwannenbad und eine separate Küche. Die Wohnung ist voll und ganz modern möbeliert. Die Fenster und die Terasse sind neu. Die geräumige Terasse hat ein Blick ins Grüne und auf dieser kann man sich gut entspannen oder sogar grillen.
Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer ruhgien, kleinen Seitenstrasse. Der Buchreinplatz ist in 4-5 Geheminuten erreichbar. Von hier können Sie der Strassenbahn ins Zentrum  von Frankfurt nehmen oder zur nächsten S Bahnstation fahren. An Bachreinplatz befinden sich auch diverse Geschäfte mit Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.

title: Offenbacher Straße, Dietzenbach
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause auf Zeit Nahe Frankfurt/Main!

Dieses gemütliche und helle 2-Zimmer Apartment befindet sich im 3. Stock eines ruhigen Mehrfamilienhauses, lässt sich bequem über einen Aufzug zu erreichen und wurde mit viel liebe zum Detail neu eingerichtet. Die 55qm Wohnung verfügt über einen Balkon und wird komplett möbliert inklusive Handtüchern und Bettwäsche vermietet. 

Die Wohnung ist ansprechend möbliert, die Küche voll ausgestattet. Sowohl Waschmaschine als auch Spülmaschine sind im Apartment vorhanden. In der hauseigenen Tiefgarage steht ein eigener Parkplatz zur Verfügung, darüber hinaus gibt es diverse Parkmöglichkeiten vor dem Haus.

Internet ist inklusive. Über den Smart TV können neben regulären TV-Sendern auch diverse Streamingdienste auf eigenen Accounts genutzt werden.

Die Wohnung liegt zentral in Dietzenbach, einem Vorort der Metropole Frankfurter. In der unmittelbaren Umgebung sind ein Fitnesstudio der „Jumpers“ Kette sowie ein Bäcker, Apotheke, Ärzte und kleine Restaurants (Italienisch, Türkisch, Amerikanisch) fußläufig erreichbar. Das Einkaufszentrum "Rathaus Center Dietzenbach" bietet alle notwendigen Einkaufmöglichkeiten von Supermarkt (Rewe) bis Elektronik (Mediamarkt) und ist zu Fuß in 5 Minuten (500m) erreichbar. Ebenfalls zu Fuß nur 10 Minuten entfernten bietet der Bahnhof "Dietzenbach Mitte" weitere Supermärkte (Lidl, Tegut) und sowie eine Drogerie (dm).
Das neue Google Rechenzentrum liegt 4 Minuten Autofahrt entfernt (20 Minuten zu Fuß).

In 7 Minuten Fahrzeit erreichen Sie zudem das Wellness Center "Garden Eden", in dem Sie sich verwöhnen lassen und vom Alltag abschalten können.

Eine Ladestation für Elektroautos befindet sich nur 200m von der Wohnung entfernt. Betrieben von der Maingau AG, kann hier auch attraktives eCar-Sharing genutzt werden (eigene Anmeldung bei Maingau AG notwendig).

Von Dietzenbach aus erreichen Sie sehr schnell alle wichtigen Ziele der Metropole Frankfurt: 
- nächste Busstation: ca. 2 Gehminuten 
- nächste S-Bahn Station: ca. 10 Gehminuten 
- Flughafen Frankfurt: 20min mit dem Auto /  56min mit der S-Bahn
- Messe Frankfurt: 35min mit dem Auto / 45min mit der S-Bahn 
- Frankfurt Zentrum: 25 min mit dem Auto / 30 min mit der S-Bahn 
- Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof: 30min mit dem Auto / 32 min mit der S-Bahn

--------------------------------------- 
Bitte beachten: 
Bei einer Belegung mit zwei Personen erhöht sich die monatliche Miete um zusätzliche 97,- € aufgrund des erhöhten Wasser- und Energieverbrauchs. 

Es gelten die Regeln der Hausordnung.

Welcome to your new temporary home!

This cozy and bright 2-bedroom apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a quiet apartment building, is easily accessible via elevator, and has been newly furnished with great attention to detail.

The 55 sq m apartment has a balcony and is rented fully furnished, including towels and bed linens. The apartment is attractively furnished, and the kitchen is fully equipped. Both a washing machine and a dishwasher are included.

A private parking space is available in the building's underground garage, and there are also several parking spaces in front of the building.

Internet access is included. In addition to regular TV channels, various streaming services can be accessed via the Smart TV with your own accounts.

The apartment is centrally located in Dietzenbach, a suburb of the metropolis of Frankfurt. In the immediate vicinity there is a fitness studio from the "Jumpers" chain as well as a bakery, pharmacy, doctors and small restaurants (Italian, Turkish, American) within walking distance. The "Rathaus Center Dietzenbach" shopping center offers all the necessary shopping options from supermarkets (Rewe) to electronics (Mediamarkt) and can be reached on foot in 5 minutes (500m). Also just 10 minutes away on foot is the "Dietzenbach Mitte" train station, which offers further supermarkets (Lidl, Tegut) and a drugstore (dm).
The new Google Data Center site is a 4 minute drive (20min walk) away.

In 7 minutes drive you can also reach the "Garden Eden" wellness center, where you can relax and switch off from everyday life.

A charging station for electric cars is located just 200m from the apartment. Operated by Maingau AG, attractive eCar sharing can also be used here (registration with Maingau AG required).

From Dietzenbach you can quickly reach all the important destinations in the metropolis of Frankfurt: 
- nearest bus station: approx. 2 minutes on foot 
- nearest S-Bahn station: approx. 10 minutes on foot 
- Frankfurt Airport: 20 minutes by car / 56 minutes by train (S-Bahn)
- Frankfurt Trade Fair: 35 minutes by car / 45 minutes by train (S-Bahn) 
- Frankfurt city center: 25 minutes by car / 30 minutes by train (S-Bahn) 
- Frankfurt Central Station: 30 minutes by car / 32 minutes by train (S-Bahn)

For long-term stays, you can book regular cleaning services through local providers.

title: Buchrainstraße, Frankfurt am Main
description:
Room for Rent in Frankfurt am Main – Perfect Location and Great Amenities!

Are you looking for a cozy and practical home in Frankfurt? This room in a beautiful maisonette apartment might be just what you’re looking for. Located only a 2-minute walk from tram lines 15 and 16, you can easily reach Südbahnhof and other parts of the city within minutes. The apartment is spread over two floors, offering extra space and privacy. There are two separate bedrooms, one on each floor, which makes it ideal for flatmates who value their own privacy. Each bedroom has its own lock for added security, and the bed measures 1.60 m x 2.00 m. The apartment features a full bathroom on the lower floor and a separate toilet upstairs, as well as two private balconies so each flatmate can enjoy their own outdoor space. The fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances such as a dishwasher and microwave, and a washing machine and dryer are available in the basement for free use.

The monthly rent is all-inclusive and covers internet, electricity, water, and heating, so you don’t have to worry about any extra bills. The location is very central and well connected, with tram lines 15 and 16 right outside the door, taking you quickly to Südbahnhof and other popular areas in Frankfurt. Shops, restaurants, and all essential amenities are nearby, making it the perfect place to enjoy life in the heart of the city.

If you’re looking for a comfortable, private, and conveniently located room with all utilities included and modern amenities, this could be the perfect fit for you. Feel free to get in touch for more information.
